examples.arabic: بعدين رجعوا بيتهم الجميل مبسوطين جداً.
examples.english: Then they returned to their beautiful house, very happy.
examples.transliteration: Ba3dein reg'ou beithom el gamil mabsootein geddan.

examples.arabic: مصطفى: أيوه، الحمد لله، هما كويسين جداً.
examples.english: Mostafa: Yes, praise be to God, they are very good.
examples.transliteration: Mostafa: Aywa, elhamdulillah, homa kwayyeseen geddan.

examples.english: The smell of the food was very beautiful.
examples.storyTitle: An Egyptian Cooking Day in Our Home

examples.arabic: أحمد وأصحابه شايلين الشنط، ويوصلوها لبيتها، ووشوشهم فرحانة جداً.
examples.english: Ahmed and his friends carry the bags, deliver them to her house, and their faces are very happy.
examples.transliteration: Ahmed w as7abo shailin el shonat, w yewassalooha lebeitha, w weshoshohom far7ana geddan.

examples.english: They were very happy with his kind words.
examples.transliteration: Hom fare7o geddan be kalam-o el 7elw.
examples.storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

examples.arabic: أحمد الصغير كان بيحب الكورة بتاعتنا جداً.
examples.english: Little Ahmed loved our football very much.
examples.transliteration: Ahmad el soghayar kan by7ebb el kora beta3tna geddan.
examples.storyTitle: Eid Joy and the African Cup in Morocco
